features.name: Milestone 1 — Foundation
features.description: Next.js App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind shell: layout, header/footer, mobile nav, reusable CTA/call button, design tokens.
features.user_visible_behavior: Site loads with a consistent responsive header/footer/nav shell on every route.
verification: manual: responsive shell check on mobile viewport
evidence: 2026-08-28: pnpm run typecheck passes (script added to package.json)
2026-08-28: pnpm run build succeeds, all 24 routes prerender (see session log)
2026-08-28: shell (Header/Footer/MobileCtaBar) rebuilt with brand logo, verified in Chrome at desktop width via screenshots + DOM text extraction
features.notes: Header/Footer/MobileCtaBar/Shell rewritten as separate components using the real brand mark (public/logo-light.png, public/logo-dark.png cropped from asset/logo.jpg) and brand colors sampled from the logo. lint script still missing — no ESLint config exists in the project and adding one requires new devDependencies/interactive `next lint` setup, out of scope for a content/design pass. Mobile-width visual check could NOT be completed this session: the browser tool's resize_window reported success but window.innerWidth stayed at 1920 regardless (confirmed via JS), so no real narrow-viewport screenshot was taken. Responsive behavior relies on standard Tailwind lg: breakpoints (same pattern as the original scaffold) but has not been visually confirmed on a small viewport — do that before marking this passing.

features.name: Milestone 2 — Database + Supabase
features.description: Drizzle schema, migrations, Supabase config, Storage buckets, RLS policies, dev-only seed data.
features.user_visible_behavior: No direct user-visible behavior; enables all content to be database-backed instead of hardcoded.
features.notes: AGENTS.md forbids hardcoding business facts in page components. Currently data/site.ts holds static content — must migrate to DB-backed content as part of this milestone.

features.name: Milestone 3 — Public content pages
features.description: Home, About, Services list/detail, Equipment category/list/detail, Projects list/detail, Contact — all content sourced from the database, no prices shown.
features.user_visible_behavior: Visitors can browse services, equipment, and projects with real content, correct empty states, and working mobile layout.
verification: confirm no rental prices appear on public pages
evidence: 2026-08-28: all public pages rebuilt with real, verified content from docs/Thong_Tin_Website_Eastern_SC.md and asset/logo.jpg (no invented business facts) — see data/site.ts
2026-08-28: invalid slugs on /dich-vu/[slug] and /thiet-bi/[slug] call notFound() -> custom app/not-found.tsx page (added this session)
2026-08-28: no rental prices anywhere on public pages (confirmed by code review of data/site.ts and all app/**/page.tsx)
2026-08-28: pnpm run build statically prerenders all 8 service detail pages and 4 equipment category pages
features.notes: Content is intentionally NOT database-backed yet (still data/site.ts) — that is feat-002's job, so this stays in_progress rather than passing. Scope was deliberately narrowed vs. the original plan: /du-an dropped its [slug] detail route and now shows a grouped reference list (Dầu khí / Điện gió) of named projects from the source doc, because no verified per-project location/date/image/gallery data exists yet — a slugged detail page would have needed invented content, which AGENTS.md forbids. Equipment is modelled as 4 categories (xe-cau has full verified specs: capacity table 6–1250 tấn, xuất xứ, đời xe, tài xế; the other 3 categories are honest 'contact for specs' pages) rather than per-unit equipment records, for the same reason. Mobile layout not visually verified this session (see feat-001 notes — tool limitation).

features.name: Milestone 4 — Admin
features.description: Admin login, protected admin layout, dashboard, company settings, and CRUD for services/equipment categories/equipment/projects, plus lead management.
features.user_visible_behavior: An authenticated admin can log in and manage all site content and leads; unauthenticated users are blocked.

features.name: Milestone 5 — Image management
features.description: Upload/delete cover and gallery images, reorder gallery, alt text, size/type validation.
features.user_visible_behavior: Admin can manage images for equipment/services/projects; images render correctly on public pages.
verification: deletion does not leave broken references

features.name: Milestone 6 — Contact leads
features.description: Public consultation form with Zod validation, persisted leads, success/error states, basic spam/rate limiting, optional Resend notification.
features.user_visible_behavior: A visitor can submit a consultation request and see a clear success or validation error; the lead shows up in admin.
verification: email failure does not lose the lead

features.name: Milestone 7 — SEO + production

features.user_visible_behavior: Public pages have correct metadata/social previews and are crawlable; production build is deployable.
